hosting.//: Redirects for the WordPress URLs that tiaracatering.com served before this site replaced it — permanent, except where a rule below notes that its destination is a temporary stand-in. Without these, every indexed page 404s at cutover. trailingSlash:false normalises /about/ to /about first, so only the extensionless form needs a rule.

redirects.//: Menu-intent URLs land on /ar/menus, the only menus page currently published — the English one is unpublished (TG-1132/TG-1133). 302 rather than the 301 the rest of this block uses: the destination is a stand-in, and a permanent redirect would sit in browser caches long after the English page returns, pinning these URLs to the Arabic one. Make them 301 to /menus when it is back.

/menus itself prerenders a 404 shell that Hosting would otherwise serve with a 200 (a soft 404), because app/menus/page.tsx calls notFound(). Redirects are evaluated ahead of static content, so this catches it. 302, not 301, because the page is coming back and neither browsers nor Google must cache it permanently. Delete this rule when app/menus/page.tsx renders again.

headers.//: Pages are requested as extensionless clean URLs (/menus, /ar), so they cannot be matched by an *.html glob. Default everything to revalidate, then let the content-addressed rules below opt back into long caching.
